label: Бейджи сторов
description: App Store + Google Play рядом, по центру. Footer/utility.
pug:
table.store-badges(role='presentation' align='center')
    tr
        td(align='center')
            a.store-badge(href='{{ appstore_link }}' target='_blank')
                img(src='{{ appstore_img }}' alt='App Store' height='40')
            a.store-badge(href='{{ gplay_link }}' target='_blank')
                img(src='{{ gplay_img }}' alt='Google Play' height='40')
